records.c: object type 15, the level's end boss: a giant fish of five columns and seven rows of sprites ($D0 to $EE), drawn by sprites 3 to 7 used again for each row by interrupts of its own, each sprite with a colour of its own. While it is on, the screen does not scroll and the level runs its own sprites ($03ED). It drifts about at random, opens its mouth every so often and spits a ball shaped like the yellow crawler across the screen to the right. Only the front of its head takes damage; it has 1,000 energy. Destroyed, it flashes, bursts into nine crawlers, opens the floor of its pool and gives 10,000 points
